notes:
COMMON JAPANESE FISH:
{鯖|さば} is one of the most commonly eaten fish in Japan.

COMMON PREPARATIONS:
- {鯖|さば}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{塩焼|しおや}き→塩焼き：12120_shioyaki⟧ - salt-grilled mackerel
- {鯖|さば}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{味噌煮|みそに}→味噌煮：21372_misoni⟧ - mackerel simmered in miso
- {鯖寿司|さばずし} - mackerel sushi
- しめ{鯖|さば} - vinegared/cured mackerel
- {鯖缶|さばかん} - canned mackerel

TYPES:
- {真鯖|まさば} - Pacific mackerel
- ごま{鯖|さば} - spotted mackerel

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
{鯖|さば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧ - to fudge numbers, to miscount (literally "to misread mackerel")

HEALTH NOTE:
{鯖|さば} is rich in DHA and EPA, omega-3 fatty acids good for health.

FAMOUS PRODUCTION AREAS:
- {福井|ふくい}⟦{県|けん}→県：02151_ken⟧ - Fukui Prefecture (famous for {鯖|さば}⟦{街道|かいどう}→街道：14040_kaidou⟧)
